record.body: Signature whistle names are individually distinctive designed whistles, one per Signature individual, in the manner of dolphin signature whistles but invented from scratch. Each whistle is defined by its start pitch, its sweep direction, and its duration, and the design includes a copying rule: a companion may repeat another's whistle when addressing it. The whistles are design parameters, not recordings of any real dolphin, and the pair says so on every record. This record covers the Signature biophony layer, distinct from ocean Signature geophony and Signature anthrophony such as designed boat noise.

demo.code:
TITLE = 'Signature Whistle Names: Designed Individual Calls'
BANDS = {'4-8 kHz': 35, '8-12 kHz': 50, '12-16 kHz': 15}
tot = float(sum(BANDS.values()))
print('Record: ' + TITLE)
print('Total: %d' % int(tot))
for k in sorted(BANDS):
    print('%s: %d (%.1f percent)' % (k, BANDS[k], 100.0 * BANDS[k] / tot))
demo.expected_output:
Record: Signature Whistle Names: Designed Individual Calls
Total: 100
12-16 kHz: 15 (15.0 percent)
4-8 kHz: 35 (35.0 percent)
8-12 kHz: 50 (50.0 percent)
